registryEntry.label: Assign CMMC L2 Azure Policy Initiative
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CMMC-L2-Initiative' -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, EnforcementMode | ConvertTo-Json
registryEntry.set_command: $policySetDef = Get-AzPolicySetDefinition -Id '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policySetDefinitions/4e50fd13-098b-3206-61d6-d1d78205cb45'; $existing = Get-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CMMC-L2-Initiative' -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $existing) { New-AzPolicyAssignment -Name 'CMMC-L2-Initiative' -DisplayName 'CMMC Level 2 Requirements' -PolicySetDefinition $policySetDef -Scope '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}' -IdentityType 'SystemAssigned' -Location '{location}' } else { Write-Output 'Assignment already exists - skipping creation' }
